subject: Model mix & pricing — follow-up and tokens breakdown
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura@brightlayer.com>, Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Model mix & pricing — follow-up and tokens breakdown

Hi Laura / Samir —

Thanks again for taking the time earlier today. Quick recap + a few asks so we can put together an apples-to-apples cost estimate and proposed pilot: 

Recap from call:
- Use cases: in-app chat assistant (customer support triage + contextual responses), semantic search/embeddings for knowledge base, and an occasional rerank step for top-N pass.
- Current telemetry: ~50k weekly active users, peak concurrency unknown (Samir to confirm).
- Success metric: reduce average handle time by 20% and improve relevant-first results in search flows.

Asks / next steps (preferably by end of week):
1) Token volume breakdown (monthly expected): percent split across chat / embeddings / rerank plus estimated average tokens per request for each (we can map to cost curves).
2) Target unit economics: are you looking for a target $/1M tokens (or a target monthly spend range)? If you have a budget band that helps us recommend model mix.
3) Any compliance/region constraints (do you require data residency in US only?).

To make this concrete, a sample table we need: monthly requests, avg tokens per request, percent of requests that use embeddings vs. chat vs. rerank. If helpful I can share a template — attaching our pricing sheet and an example volume template.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet-v2.xlsx (pricing tiers, $/1M token examples), brightlayer_token_volumes_q2.xlsx (volume template)

I copied Marcus (solutions) and Aisha (pricing) to help with unit economics and a recommended model mix once we have volumes.

Proposed next step: if you can drop the rough splits I’ll send a 2-slide cost model and a proposed 4-week pilot plan.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123
---
Redwood Inference — production-first inference for LLMs

From: Laura Jenkins <laura@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlayer.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — follow-up and tokens breakdown

Thanks Marissa — great summary. Quick answers inline and a couple of estimates: 

- Chat (customer support assistant): ~60% of calls. Avg tokens per chat reply: ~120 tokens (short replies), but longer context windows for escalation flows (~450 tokens) might occur ~10% of the time.
- Embeddings (semantic search + KB): ~30% of calls. Avg tokens for embedding payload: ~1,000 tokens (we send whole doc chunks for indexing) but per-query embeddings are ~64 tokens.
- Rerank (served after retrieval): ~10% of calls. Rerank input avg tokens: ~600 tokens; we run rerank on top-20.

Monthly volume: we expect to be around 20M tokens per month to start, scaling to 60–80M over next 6 months if pilot looks good.

Budget: we have an initial pilot budget of $8k–$12k for the first month. For production we expect an engineering budget sign-off target of $30k–$50k/month depending on ROI.

Data residency: US-only required for now. SOC 2 in scope (we discussed).

I attached a filled-in version of your template with our rough numbers (see brightlayer_token_volumes_q2.xlsx). Happy to hop on another call if useful.

Laura
Laura Jenkins
Head of Product, BrightLayer
laura@brightlayer.com | +1 646 555 0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Jenkins <laura@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — follow-up and tokens breakdown

Laura — perfect, this is exactly what we need. A few clarifying Qs so our model recommendation lines up with your budget target: 

1) The 20M tokens/month pilot budget of $8k–$12k implies a target blended rate of roughly $100–$600 per 1M tokens depending on model choices. For planning: what's your target $/1M tokens (if you have an internal target), or should we optimize for max quality within that $8k–$12k band?
2) For embeddings: when you say 1,000 tokens for doc chunks, is that for indexing only (batch offline) and queries are ~64 tokens (online)? We usually recommend batching indexing to reduce cost and using smaller models for embeddings in production.
3) For rerank: is rerank latency sensitivity high (sub-200ms) or can you tolerate 500–800ms for better-quality models? That changes our recommended model class for rerank.

Next steps from our side: Marcus will put together a 2-slide cost comparison (cheap/medium/quality model mixes) showing projected monthly spend for the 20M and 60M scenarios. Aisha will sketch recommended $/1M targets by model class and suggested batching/caching knobs to hit the pilot budget.

Would you prefer we share the cost slides first or schedule a short call to walk through? We can be flexible — happy to send slides first.

Thanks —
Marissa

From: Samir Patel <samir.patel@brightlayer.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Laura Jenkins <laura@brightlayer.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Jun 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Model mix & pricing — follow-up and tokens breakdown

Hey team — quick note to confirm: we prefer slides first so the PM and finance leads can review before a call. I've attached our internal volume projection (brightlayer_token_volumes_q2.xlsx) with a couple of extra columns for expected growth.

Also: on rerank latency — we can tolerate up to ~500ms for higher quality if it's a once-per-session step (not on the critical path for all queries).

Thanks and looking forward to the slides.

Samir
VP Engineering | BrightLayer
samir.patel@brightlayer.com | +1 415 555 0444
